title: Relabelled partite matching graph
statement: Let $r,k\in\mathbb{N}$, and let a perfect matching be given in the complete multipartite graph with $2r$ parts of size $k$. Transport its edges to the vertex set of size $2rk$ using the canonical bijection from the partite vertices; the resulting graph has two vertices adjacent exactly when their corresponding partite vertices are joined by the matching.
hypotheses_covered: A perfect matching in the complete multipartite graph with $2r$ parts of size $k$
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the canonical vertex bijection it invokes, so its exact ordering of vertices cannot be specified from the given definitions.
